title.narrative: Promoting Sustainable and Socially Inclusive Labour Market Integration

description.narrative:
Contract's objective is to increase formal employment of Syrians under Temporary Protection, Persons under International Protection and host community members and strengthen the harmonization process in Türkiye

Specific Objectives are:

  1. Improved level of employability of SuTPs, PuIPs and host community members
  2. Strengthened capacity of government and non-government institutions as well as employers to improve access of SuTPs, PuIPs and host community members to information, employment opportunities, and protection safeguards.
  3. Increased effectiveness of government and non-government institutions in providing employment support services to SuTPs, PuIPs and host community members
  4. Improved level of social cohesion between SuTPs, PuIPs and host community members in their community and workplaces
